name: Ivan III of Russia
role: Grand Prince of Moscow from 1462 to 1505
contribution: Grand Prince of Moscow and all Russia from 1462 until his death in 1505.

checks.lead: Ivan III Vasilyevich (Russian: Иван III Васильевич; 22 January 1440 – 27 October 1505), also known as Ivan the Great, was Grand Prince of Moscow and all Russia from 1462 until his death in 1505. Ivan served as the co-ruler and regent for his blind father Vasily II before he officially ascended the throne.
